# Inventory Published and Ownership

All assets published from this repository are owned by Team Virtuoso (`@newrelic/virtuoso`),
which is accountable for every published artifact, its integrity, and its publish path.

For the full inventory including CLI assets and access control details, see
[`newrelic/newrelic-cli/.github/PUBLISHING.md`](https://github.com/newrelic/newrelic-cli/blob/main/.github/PUBLISHING.md).
